title: Faster after a quiet spell
summary: Your AI's first call after a while away no longer waits on price checks or on reading your sign-in again.

payload.title: Back faster after a pause
payload.body: When you or your AI come back after a pause, Trillion used to read your sign-in again from far away and look up the price it quotes you before answering. Now your sign-in is kept nearby for a day, and the price is looked up at the same time as your account is checked, so the first answer comes sooner. Your account still checks every sign-in each time, so a sign-in you ended stays ended.
